# 283_R6FIX.20 — billing period tick: one row per billing_account (BL-120)

## Summary

- **Defect (BL-120, RH-A2-8):** `runBillingPeriodTick` ran `join workspaces` on
  `billing_account_id` — an account with N workspaces produced N rows per subscription, so the
  7-day downgrade warning and lapse notice were sent once per workspace (each addressed to a
  different workspace's owner, against the stale `downgrade_warned_at` snapshot) and counters
  inflated. Same join class as RH-3's auto-reload sweep.
- **Fix:** both queries (subs + free-tier daily allowance) now use the RH-3 `join lateral`
  home-workspace pick (`order by created_at, id limit 1`) — one row per subscription/account;
  every arm was already keyed on `s.id`/`b.id`, so behavior is otherwise identical.
- Records also carry dated closures: BL-117 email-change token (#351 landed tokenHash +
  timingSafeEqual; legacy rows TTL-bounded) and BL-117 duplicate personal workspaces (= BL-115 →
  #364). No code for either.
